response.sql: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_totals), with_avg AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_avg FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with NULL traitcount are excluded, so a site whose rows all have NULL traitcount has no total and is left out of the site set. The average share is therefore taken over sites that have at least one non-null count.

A site's share is its summed traitcount divided by the grand total of all non-null traitcount. The average share is the plain mean of the per-site shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of sites.
The margin is share minus the average share. No rounding is applied.
